App Review: Muse

Muse is a personal AI agent designed to help you manage everyday tasks and achieve your goals. From organizing emails and booking restaurants to tracking expenses and discovering deals, Muse handles tasks with your approval and keeps you informed along the way.

Personal Productivity

Muse helps reduce everyday busywork by managing schedules, resolving calendar conflicts, booking reservations, setting reminders, and following up on important tasks. Stay organized with your calendar, emails, deadlines, and daily plans without having to remember everything yourself.

Shopping and Deals

Compare prices, monitor product costs, and receive alerts when items you're interested in go on sale. Muse can also assist with purchases on your behalf, subject to your approval and configured permissions.

Connect Your Apps

Connect supported services, including email, calendars, social media, health and fitness platforms, and financial accounts. You control which information Muse can access and can review or approve actions before they are performed.

Grow Your Small Business

Set business goals, such as attracting new customers or increasing sales, and let Muse help work toward them. Connect supported business accounts, including Instagram Business, Facebook Pages, and Meta advertising tools, to help it understand your products, brand communication, and customer interactions.

Save Money

Understand your spending habits, track expenses, review subscriptions, and identify potentially unnecessary charges. Muse can help you manage budgets and savings goals while requesting approval before making purchases, spending money, or canceling subscriptions.

Health and Fitness

Use Muse as a personalized fitness and wellness assistant. Based on the information you choose to share, it can help create workout routines and meal plans, track nutrition, review sleep patterns, and adapt recommendations to your progress and goals.

Manage Tasks from Start to Finish

Delegate complete tasks to Muse, including research, comparisons, communication, and bookings. Whether you're planning a trip, negotiating a bill, or preparing to sell a vehicle, Muse can help coordinate multiple steps toward a desired outcome.

Always Working for You

Muse can continue working on supported tasks even when you're not actively using the app. It can monitor relevant updates, follow up when needed, and notify you when something requires your attention.

Stay in Control

Review and approve actions before they are carried out. Muse provides an activity history to help you track its work, and you can disconnect linked services or revoke access whenever necessary.

Make It Your Own

Personalize Muse by choosing its name, adjusting its communication style, and customizing how it interacts with you to create a more familiar experience.

Smart, but Still Learning

Although Muse is designed to be helpful and capable, it may occasionally provide inaccurate information or take unexpected actions. Review its work, provide feedback, and intervene when necessary to ensure tasks are completed as intended.
